accessibility.description: Gwent Access reads menus, cards, popups and the battle board through NVDA, with keyboard commands for playing matches, mulligans, passing and ending turns, building decks, single-player content, online play and the shop. The game's launcher requires a GOG login that is hard to complete with NVDA, so a sighted helper may be needed once; after that a desktop shortcut skips the launcher. The mod is made for the Windows Steam version.
